target_text: tinjau terlebih dahulu kasus ketika setiap $f_n$ tak-negatif.

provenance.basis: exact active Hint macro 1 associated with exercise 123Xc

source_text:
note that if $a_0\in\dom F$ and $a_0<a<b$ then there is some
$M$ such that
$xe^{-sx}|f(x)|\le Me^{-a_0x}|f(x)|$ whenever $x\in\coint{0,\infty}$,
$s\in[a,b]$.
target_text:
perhatikan bahwa jika $a_0\in\dom F$ dan $a_0<a<b$, maka
terdapat suatu $M$ sedemikian sehingga
$xe^{-sx}|f(x)|\le Me^{-a_0x}|f(x)|$ setiap kali
$x\in\coint{0,\infty}$, $s\in[a,b]$.

provenance.basis: exact active Hint macro 2 associated with exercise 123Xc

source_text:
use Lebesgue's Dominated
Convergence Theorem to show that $\lim_{n\to\infty}F(s_n)=0$ whenever
$\lim_{n\to\infty}s_n=\infty$.
target_text:
gunakan Teorema Konvergensi
Terdominasi Lebesgue untuk menunjukkan bahwa
$\lim_{n\to\infty}F(s_n)=0$ setiap kali
$\lim_{n\to\infty}s_n=\infty$.
